payout_value_note: Flat $50 credited to the referrer's checking account per qualifying personal checking referral; friend earns $50 too. No annual cap (unlimited referrals/rewards).
payout_quote: Invite A Friend is a referral program that rewards you with $50 (credited to your checking account) for every friend you refer who opens a qualified personal checking account and completes the required actions. Your friend benefits too – they also earn $50 (credited to their checking account).
numeric_basis: payout from official refer.centier.com FAQ ('$50 (credited to your checking account) for every friend you refer'); time: referral share signup + link sharing est. 5-15 min active
eligibility: Centier Bank clients 18+; referred friend must not have an active personal checking account with Centier nor have had one in the last 12 months.
steps: Visit centier.com/invite-a-friend and sign up with your information to get your unique share link
Invite friends via text, email, or Facebook using your link
Friend clicks the link, signs up, opens a qualified personal checking account, and enrolls in e-Statements, Digital Banking, or Direct Deposit within 90 days
$50 reward deposited to both referrer's and friend's checking accounts within 90 days of account opening

catches: Official FAQ: 'for every friend you refer who opens a qualified personal checking account and completes the required actions'
Ineligible friends: those who 'currently have an active personal checking account or had an active personal checking account in the last 12 months'
Reward deposited 'within 90 days of account opening' — payout is not immediate
Money Market accounts are not included in the personal Invite A Friend program
Friend must complete enrollment in e-Statements, Digital Banking, or Direct Deposit within the first 90 days
No annual cap stated: 'You can invite an unlimited number of friends! ... The number of rewards is unlimited.'
timing: Referral link signup and sharing takes ~10 minutes active; the $50 reward is deposited to the referrer's checking account within 90 days of the friend's account opening.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 from the official Centier Bank referral FAQ (refer.centier.com/zones/faq). Distinct from the Centier Bank Invite A Business program (business checking), verified separately as R3391.
